notes: Nevco MPCW-7 is a handheld/desktop wired-or-wireless scoreboard console controller (11in x 9.5in x 4in, 3.35 lb; not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted). No signal-graded connectors (HDMI/SDI/USB/RJ45-network/DP) are present — the two BNC jacks carry Nevco's proprietary coax control/data protocol to the scoreboard, not SDI video, so no grade was set. Port physical details (BNC output x2, dual hand-held-switch jacks, 9V DC barrel power input) came from the rear-view diagram (Figure 2) in Nevco's official MPCW-7 Operator's Instructions manual (hosted on nevco.com's own docs S3 bucket); dimensions/range/capacity came from the manufacturer product page https://www.nevco.com/product/mpcw-7-wireless-wired/. Optional wireless receiver is a separate accessory box, not a physical port on the MPCW-7 unit itself, so it was not listed as a port. Hand-held-switch jack connector type was approximated to "rj45" as the closest schema id — actual hardware is a smaller coiled modular phone-jack style connector, not true 8P8C RJ45.
